dependency_monitoring: Group all shared Lanrith workflow dependency alerts in one Dependabot PR. Verified source metadata and human source review remain mandatory; no updates are ignored or automatically approved.
fresh_approval_scope: A new independent human must review and approve the entire current candidate source, including the earlier feature changes and this controller rollout, after all new exact-head CI passes. The publication audit includes the full diff from the last published component source to this candidate, not just the controller changes visible in the PR diff. Only that new actual approval can authorize a subsequent source publication.
